boundedGeneralRepairProposal: Emit a typed verifier_validation substage and invariant code from the shared parser. Preserve only bounded diagnostic structure (verdict boolean, issue types/count, advisory question count, valid index range/count and field lengths) plus the candidate/evidence fingerprints; do not infer a legal mistake from malformed review metadata.

Express applicable shape constraints and valid optional indices in the supported strict schema where feasible, while retaining local cross-field validation as the final gate. Pass requires no substantive issues; failure requires at least one valid issue and no advisory acceptance questions. Optional edits must refer only to actual candidate entries and an authorized issue type.

Add at most one automatic verifier-envelope correction after a completed model review fails protocol validation, subject to existing shared provider-call/spend/time limits and cancellation/context identity gates. Reuse the same immutable proposed answer and evidence; provide the exact validator invariant plus original parsed verdict and ask for a coherent fresh review. It is a review correction, not legal answer regeneration or an extra retrieval run.

Run the identical parser, source-binding and mapped-scope checks on the corrected review. A valid failed review must enter the existing bounded answer revision/verification flow; it must never be converted to pass. A still-invalid review must remain a nonanswer. Do not drop issues, advisory fields, substantive qualifications or invalid indices simply to make the old verdict acceptable.

After bounded protocol recovery is exhausted, persist a truthful canonical system processing recovery with the question/history retained and no charge. Do not fabricate missing project facts or a source conclusion. Route it to an explanation/report action consistently; transport retry remains distinct. This backend handling follows the repair attempt rather than substituting a UI message for validation.
